Anna (PM): Quick sync — after launch we need to decide: focus next 2 sprints on stabilization (customer bugs + reliability) or ship a small "next wave" features slice? I want tradeoffs and what blocks each option.

Raj (Eng): leaning stabilize. p95 gen latency +18% on corp workloads yesterday, KV-cache misses spiking. Shipping more features will make debugging harder.

Sam (CS): A couple of paying customers asked for Feature X; it's a 2-week build. They said it's blocking their roadmaps but ok with a canary.

Luca (PD): If we do a feature slice, keep it limited to 1 small surface (web SDK). We can postpone heavy server-side changes. We need launch criteria either way.

Maya (SRE): Stabilize plan: KV cache hotfix + trace sampling tune. Estimated 7 work-days total (Raj + 1). Can implement emergency rollout policy.

Raj (Eng): Proposed rollout criteria for stabilize:
```
- p95 latency <= baseline + 5%
- error rate < 0.2% per 24h
- successful canary for 12h
```
If we miss any, roll back and schedule deep-dive.

Anna (PM): OK. What about customers asking for Feature X? Sam, can we offer a short-term workaround or early access on Dedicated?

Sam (CS): Yes — offer Dedicated early access + weekly check-ins. That should buy time. Most customers ok with that if we promise ETA < 6 weeks.

Luca (PD): So decision: prioritize stabilize in mainline for next 2 sprints, and schedule Feature X as a gated canary on Dedicated. Document criteria and owners.

Anna (PM): Agree. Owners: Raj (eng lead), Maya (SRE lead), Sam (customer comms), Luca (feature owner). I'll update the roadmap and set a sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Deploy canary 1690-hotfix scheduled by Raj for 1970012355

Raj (Eng): I'll kick off the patch later today and post PR link.
